name: ESTELIN SUNSCREEN 50G – ALL IN ONE
short_description: Tinted sunscreen gives your skin all-day sun protection and has a unique self-adjusting formula that blends into all skin tones. It is absorbed by the skin and reduces the appearance of dark spots and blemishes. It is non-greasy, water resistant, gives light coverage, prevents tanning, and makes your skin look radiant.
description:
Benefits: Tinted sunscreen gives your skin all-day sun protection and has a unique self-adjusting formula that blends into all skin tones. It is absorbed by the skin and reduces the appearance of dark spots and blemishes. It is non-greasy, water resistant, gives light coverage, prevents tanning, and makes your skin look radiant

Use For: Body Sunscreen

Feature: Protection and Hevis Light Defense – Lightweight Non-Greasy – Fast Absorbing Texture with a Matte Finish

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Ingredients: Aqua, Ethylhexyl palmitate, mineral oil, propylene glycol, glycerin, dimethicone, glyceryl stearate, phenoxyethanol, peg-100 stearate, octocrylene, Cetearyl Alcohol, Ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, titanium dioxide, carbomer, triethanolamine, ceteareth-25, methylparaben, ci 77492, acrylates/ammonium methacrylate copolymer, niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, ascorbic acid, hydrolyzed pearl, triethoxycaprylylsilane, ci 77499, bht, ethylhexylglycerin, chlorphenesin, aroma

How To Use : Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply after 40 minutes of swimming or sweating, immediately after towel drying, at least every 2 hours. If used with other skincare products, use it as a last step in the regimen. Can be used alone or under makeup.
